title: Riftn: I‑internet yadala ivula. Umhlaba omusha uphakama.
h1: Riftn: I‑internet yadala ivula. Umhlaba omusha uphakama.
body:
I‑protocol yezokuxhumana evulekile owuyinhloko.

Igama

Riftn yisenzakalo sokuphazamiseka okuphezulu. Igama lisho “rifting”, inqubo yezolimo ehlukanisa isikhumba somhlaba, ivule umoya wokushisa, idale izimvula ezinzima, futhi idale olwandle, umhlaba kanye nokuphila okusha. Noma yikuphi ukuvulwa kuvula okuthile okudala futhi kwakha okusha. Igama lethu lifaka leyo mbono: ukuphazamiseka kudala.

Inkinga

Kwesikhathi esidlule, amabhizinisi amabili amakhulu wathola i‑internet. Bane umphakathi wakho, ukufinyelela kwakho kanye nemali yakho. Ukushintsha kwe‑policy kwasusa konke. Abanikazi abane‑million followers baphela ebusuku, imithetho ayibuyekezwa. Iphutha labo? Ukwakha emhlabeni owathengekile.

Okwakha

Riftn ivula lo mhlaba: i‑protocol yezokuxhumana evulekile, eyakhiwe ngabantu. Wonke umuntu angakha, angayihlukanisa noma angayisebenzisa. Izicelo zethu ezithile sezisebenza kulo: ividiyo, ama‑shorts, ama‑live streams, umculo, imiyalezo egciniwe, imiphakathi, imidlalo kanye ne‑wallet eyakhelwe ngaphakathi. Yenza i‑mint yoku‑upload ngqo ku‑wallet yakho. Gcina ku‑99% kwento oyithola. Isikhathi siyahlela i‑feed yakho, hhayi i‑algorithm yengcindezi. I‑handle yakho, @you@riftn.com, ihamba kwi‑web evulekile.

Kwakhiwe ngokucela

Ukuba nomhlaba kusho okungaphezu kokugcina izithombe zakho. Ku‑Riftn, noma ubani angacela noma yini: isici, umdlalo, isipiliyoni esisha. Sikwakha. Uma sivumelana nabanye, siyithumela njengokumisiwe. Uma sivumelana nawe kuphela, isebenza ezilungiselelweni zakho. I‑protocol eyodwa, izinguqulo eziningi. Ukuhlelwa okukhulu kuyisigaba esilandelayo se‑internet. Ukuba nomhlaba kuyenza kube khona. Riftn ingaba umhlaba wokugcina wokuxhumana kwabathengi, futhi siyakwakha ukuze isebenze iminyaka eminingi. Kungani ukwakha enye uma wonke umuntu esebenzisa leyo? Umbuzo omuhle. Futhi uma usafuna, yenza: konke kuyavuleka ngokuphelele.

Amanani e‑crypto ayikho

Ayikho imisho yokusakaza. Ayikho imali yokushisa. Ayikho i‑wallet yokumisa. Ngena nge‑Google, i‑Apple, i‑email noma ifoni, futhi i‑Riftn idala i‑wallet yakho ngokushesha. Kubukeka kuyinto evamile. Ngaphansi, i‑blockchain ibhalisa konke.

Kungani sikhona

Abadlali, abahlinzeki be‑stream kanye nabathuthukisi, abakhathazekile nge‑censorship kanye nokuhlola kwengqondo, bathumele i‑protocol ngo‑2021 ngaphansi kwelithi FTV. Ngokuqalisa kwaba ne‑$4M emali engenayo. Sabelane nge‑$1M nabanikazi be‑token, sithumele i‑$1M ekuthuthukiseni kanye ne‑roadmap yeminyaka emihlanu, futhi sithumele i‑$2M ku‑BNB ukuthenga futhi sibhale i‑token yethu. Qinisekisa inombolo ngayinye ku‑blockchain kanye nepheji lethu le‑stats. I‑FTV yaba yi‑DeHub, futhi ngo‑November 2026, i‑DeHub yaba yi‑Riftn. Ithimba elifanayo, umdlalo ofanayo, umgomo omkhulu. I‑token entsha ye‑Riftn izoqalisa maduze. Ayikashintshi okwamanje.

Isimemo

Umhlaba omusha awunawo umphathi. Thola owakho ngaphambi komunye umuntu ekha umdwebo. Bese uhlole ubuchwepheshe, i‑token kanye nezicelo ezihambisa i‑rift.

Isaziso Esibalulekile

Amathokeni e-Riftn asebenza njengamathokeni okusebenza ngaphakathi kwe-ecosystem yethu, afana nemali yemidlalo, futhi awona amathuluzi okutshala imali. Yonke imimakethe inezingozi eziyimvelo.
